public_fields: text, decision_key and revision are model-supplied assertions, never grants or semantic sameness proof

cases.case: same notification identity after origin, base, port, session or path change
cases.expected: confirmed duplicate or terminal unknown before Inbox

cases.case: changed asserted key and/or revision, same known canonical request
cases.expected: held canonical_identity_conflict; attempted identity becomes terminal unknown; original association unchanged

cases.case: validated known send IDs then failed full read
cases.expected: association retained as send-known, no target admission, terminal unknown

cases.case: v1 identity with no native IDs
cases.expected: exact old identity still suppresses; fresh asserted identity in that destination scope holds legacy_history_unmapped

cases.case: two distinct notification identities, distinct native requests, fresh explicitly initialized v2
cases.expected: both can succeed; this is not proof of semantic distinctness

cases.case: changed assertion plus new/unknown native IDs or a different authority with no verified alias
cases.expected: semantic sameness cannot be established; no cross-key semantic guarantee; never automatic retry or no-history inference
